title: How decision-making moved, 6 to 22 November 2026
for: strategy.d (what it means); studio.d (to tell as a story); Dinis (to see the play)

sources_read.claude: PrompTugal__News__Website CLAUDE.md, 'Decisions are pages' (Dinis's word, 6 Nov 2026) and 'When in doubt, push to production' (6 Nov), read 22 Nov 2026
sources_read.guidance: board/guidance/README.md, New from Dinis: signed commits (19 Nov 01:05) and twins do not talk across accounts (22 Nov 01:45), read 22 Nov 2026
sources_read.holacracy: board/team/holacracy.d/status.json: org chart first drawn about 22 Nov 03:58Z; and maestro.d's Holacracy analysis (22 Nov about 02:00 UTC), read 22 Nov 2026
sources_read.strategy: board/team/strategy.d/maps/2026-11-22-decision-making/map.json v0.1.0: the end positions, and the evidence for playable brief (about 09:05 UTC), context brief (13:25 UTC) and decisions.d, read 22 Nov 2026
sources_read.cartographer: cartographer.d's reading: where a component stood when it began. These are my judgement, not measurements, and strategy.d may correct them

rule: A step is a dated event that moves or creates a component. Evolution: 0 genesis, 0.25 custom, 0.5 product, 0.75 commodity. A component with no step yet is not drawn.

steps.caption: 6 November: decisions become pages, with every option shown. The first form of the idea.
Still 6 November: the owner's recommendation is the default; push it and try it live.
19 November: signed commits for every agent. Identity becomes a working product.
22 November, early: the first org chart, the record of who holds what, is drawn by an agent.
22 November, morning: Dinis asks for decisions to be playable and answerable from one place. A prototype is asked for.
22 November, afternoon: strategy draws the first map. The page and the keys are placed; the record starts to take shape; the context brief begins.

notes: Dates and what happened come from the sources named on each step; positions are my reading.
Only the components with a dated source are shown. The full map is decision-making.wardley.json.
The next step to add is whatever moves next: each time a move is made, a step is appended here with its source.
